tutorial.title: How Student Profile Works
tutorial.subtitle: Tutorial
tutorial.heroDesc: Find, view and update student records for your school. Start with the basics, then explore editing, analytics and exports.
tutorial.gettingStartedDesc: Sign in and set up your view: branch, session and language.
tutorial.gs1Desc: Open Student Profile from the Awfatech app launcher and you're signed in automatically. Otherwise, enter your organisation's app code and log in with your staff account.
tutorial.gs2Desc: Use the branch selector at the top of Overview, Dashboard and Students. HQ users can choose "All branches"; branch staff always see their own branch.
tutorial.gs3Desc: On the Students page, the session selector next to the branch decides which session's classes and levels are used. It follows the current session unless you pick another year.
tutorial.gs4Desc: Switch between Bahasa Melayu and English, or light and dark mode, from the top bar. More preferences are in Settings.
tutorial.gsTip: Your branch choice is remembered as you move between pages in this browser tab.
tutorial.overviewDesc: A quick snapshot of the students in the selected branch.
tutorial.ov1Desc: See active students, this year's intake, former students and the total number of records at a glance.
tutorial.ov2Desc: The bars show students by status and active students by education level. Click any row to open the student list already filtered to it.
tutorial.ov3Desc: The newest active students are listed at the bottom. Click one to find them in the student list, or use View all.
tutorial.findStudentsDesc: Search and filter the student list to find exactly who you need.
tutorial.fs1Desc: Type a name, IC number, matric number or UID in the search box. Results update as you type.
tutorial.fs2Desc: Narrow the list by status, academic year, class and education level. "Clear filters" puts everything back except the branch.
tutorial.fs3Desc: Sort by latest or by name, and choose how many rows to show per page at the bottom of the table.
tutorial.fs4Desc: Each row shows the student's class and intake, both parents with their IC and phone, the birth, register and end dates, and the status.
tutorial.fsTip: The list starts with Active students only. Choose "All statuses" to include completed, withdrawn and terminated students.
tutorial.viewStudentDesc: See everything recorded about a student on one page.
tutorial.vs1Desc: Click the eye icon on a student's row to open their full profile.
tutorial.vs2Desc: Personal details, father, mother, emergency contact, siblings, your school's extra fields, vaccine details and the online registration record are all on one page. Empty sections are hidden.
tutorial.vs3Desc: The left panel shows enrolment details: register and end dates, register number, class, school account, sponsor, mentor, who is billed (Father or Mother) and the branch.
tutorial.editStudentDesc: Update a student's record section by section.
tutorial.es1Desc: Click the pencil icon on a row, or Edit at the top of a student's profile.
tutorial.es2Desc: Administration, Student, Father, Mother, Siblings, Emergency Contact and Other Information (your school's own fields). Change only what you need.
tutorial.es3Desc: Press Submit. Only the sections you changed are saved. If one part can't be saved you'll see which one and why — fix it and press Submit again to retry just that part.
tutorial.es4Desc: Use Upload Image in the left panel to replace the profile photo. It is saved together with the Administration details.
tutorial.esTip: Every sibling you keep needs a name. Completely empty sibling rows are ignored when saving.
tutorial.analyticsDesc: Charts that summarise the students of the selected branch.
tutorial.an1Desc: See active students by intake year, gender split, registrations per month, education level, class, age and status.
tutorial.an2Desc: Hover over any bar to see its exact count.
tutorial.an3Desc: HQ users can choose All branches to combine every branch. With many branches this takes longer to load.
tutorial.exportPrintDesc: Take the student list out of the system as a spreadsheet or on paper.
tutorial.ex1Desc: Tick the students you want. If none are ticked, the students on the current page are used.
tutorial.ex2Desc: Downloads a spreadsheet with student details and both parents' names, IC numbers and phone numbers.
tutorial.ex3Desc: Opens a printer-friendly list that also shows the branch and filters you used.
tutorial.tipsDesc: Shortcuts and where to get help.
tutorial.tp1Desc: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on a Mac) or click the search icon in the top bar to go straight to any page.
tutorial.tp2Desc: For security you are signed out after a period of inactivity. Just sign in again to continue where you left off.
tutorial.tp3Desc: Open your profile menu at the top right and choose Submit ticket to contact support, or My tickets to follow up on earlier requests.
